objectives.description: Confirm the plan-vs-state divergence detector gap still holds
Add plan_level_equivalent and check_plan_state_divergence helpers; wire into all four branches before their no-artifact early exits
Harden find_latest_artifact against a pre-existing empty-directory set -e/pipefail crash discovered during fixture testing
Fixture-verify mismatch WARNING + byte-identical, matching case no WARNING, no-plan-file case no WARNING/no error, and full Phase 1-5 regression sweep

deviations.description: Fix a pre-existing latent bug in find_latest_artifact() discovered while fixture-testing Phase 5's no-plan-file case
deviations.reason: An existing-but-empty artifact subdirectory made ls fail against an unexpanded glob, and set -euo pipefail aborted the whole script with exit 2 instead of a normal no-op. This directly undermines the non-fatal/visible guarantees Phases 2-4 build on top of reconcile-task-status.sh, so it was fixed in-place rather than left as a trap for the new callers.
deviations.annotation: See Phase 5 task checklist's unplanned item for the full note.
